attacks.name: Genetic Splicing
steps: After all attacks generated by this attack have been resolved, this character gains 1 |!power| and 1 |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| token.

attacks.name: Recombinant Disintegration
steps: When creating the dice pool for each attack, this character may remove 1 |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| token from itself. If it does, add 2 dice to that attack roll.

|!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |*Genetic Burst|: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| token and each enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Engineered Perfection
superPowers.body: Remove any number of |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| tokens from this character. Remove 1 special condition from this character for each Genetic Sample token removed. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Genetic Negation
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character and remove 1 |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| token from this character. If you do, the chosen character gains the |§root§Root| special condition.

superPowers.name: Such Fun Little Playthings
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3. Advance it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Molecular Regeneration
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer |!damage|, it may use this superpower. Remove any number of |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| tokens from this character. Reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1 for each Genetic Sample removed.

superPowers.name: DNA Database
superPowers.body: This character starts the game with 1 |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| token and may have a maximum of 3 |<genetic_sample>Genetic Sample| tokens at any time. Additionally, whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least 1 |!critical|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and increased from 5 to 7 on Injured side.
The Strike attack was removed (basic builder attack).
Genetic Splicing's Power Cost decreased from 1 to 0. It now grants 1 |!power| in addition to 1 Genetic Sample token after all its attacks are resolved.
Recombinant Disintegration reworked into a fixed Area 2 attack (previously a variable-range area attack based on Genetic Sample tokens held).
Doctor Sinister can now use 1 Genetic Sample token to add 2 dice to an attack roll of Recombinant Disintegration.
Recombinant Disintegration's Power Cost decreased from 6 to 5. The Genetic Burst special rule now also grants a Genetic Sample token.
DNA Database now grants a starting Genetic Sample token and grants 1 |!power| whenever this character rolls at least 1 |!critical|.
